title: A Refusal He Would Not Hear

scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Victor came here after the funeral. He said we could start again.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: That I would rather remain unmarried than return to him.

dialogues.speaker: Victor
dialogues.text: Yet you found another man soon enough.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: You heard my refusal. You just decided it could not be real.
